candidates.titulo: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
candidates.resumen:
Bluesky's Attie AI tool, which initially launched earlier this year as a way to use AI to build your own feeds, now lets you make "small" social apps like games, polls, and dashboards that you can then share with others as their own websites. In an interview at TechCrunch Disrupt, Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider said to think of Attie as "social vibe coding or vibe coding for your community."

candidates.titulo: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch

candidates.titulo: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
candidates.resumen: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

candidates.titulo: Friends don’t let friends feed their data to AI agents
candidates.resumen: There's a growing trend in the consumer tech world: gadgets designed to spy on everything and everyone around you, regardless of whether or not anyone else actually consented to it.
